title: Evidence-bound hypothesis matrix for the 1977 Wow! signal
scope_note: The matrix separates model compatibility, source function, source origin, and symbolic intent. A compatible hypothesis is not identified as true, and a reproducible transformation is not treated as recovered transmitter intent.

hypotheses.label: Gaussian transit-shaped envelope
hypotheses.proposition: The retained six-sample strength envelope is compatible with a source crossing a telescope beam under a zero-baseline Gaussian response model.
hypotheses.rationale: The Gaussian model produces small residuals and the lowest leave-one-out error among the four predeclared shape models.
would_strengthen: Independent recovery of higher-resolution samples showing the same beam-response envelope.
Instrument records confirming the applicable Big Ear beam parameters for the observed declination and channel.
would_weaken: Recovered samples showing incompatible multi-peaked or discontinuous structure at the retained cadence.
A validated receiver artifact that reproduces the envelope without a sky transit.
limitations: Shape-model support does not identify the emitter, its location, its natural or artificial origin, or its intent.

hypotheses.label: Stable artificial carrier or beacon
hypotheses.proposition: A stable artificial carrier or beacon could produce the coarse retained strength envelope after convolution with the telescope beam.
hypotheses.rationale: The retained measurements do not exclude a stable narrowband artificial carrier, but they contain no preserved modulation or source-identifying evidence.
would_strengthen: A repeat detection from the same sky position with stable narrowband coherence and instrument-independent confirmation.
Resolved modulation, synchronization, coding, or Doppler behavior inconsistent with known terrestrial interference and natural emission.
would_weaken: A repeatable natural mechanism reproducing the frequency, strength, duration, and beam-transit behavior.
Traceable terrestrial or instrumental interference matching the historical event.
limitations: Compatibility with a beacon is not evidence that a beacon existed or that any artificial source was extraterrestrial.

hypotheses.label: Natural versus artificial source origin
hypotheses.proposition: The surviving six strength measurements alone do not discriminate between a natural narrowband event and an artificial carrier-like source.
hypotheses.rationale: The beam-shaped envelope constrains observed geometry, while the retained data omit the fine timing, phase, polarization, and spectral structure needed for origin classification.
would_strengthen: Recovery of raw or higher-resolution archival data containing discriminating spectral, temporal, polarization, or Doppler structure.
A confirmed recurrence enabling simultaneous observation by independent instruments.
would_weaken: No additional evidence can make the six coarse measurements alone discriminate origin; the limitation is information-theoretic.
limitations: This status records unresolved discrimination, not equal prior probability for natural and artificial hypotheses.

hypotheses.label: Intentional Morse question mark
hypotheses.proposition: The historical source intentionally encoded an International Morse question mark in the retained six-sample envelope.
hypotheses.rationale: The question-mark correspondence is reproducible under one threshold and polarity, but the opposite polarity yields a comma and the exact permutation control shows the pattern is not rare enough to establish intent.
would_strengthen: A predeclared decoding rule independently recovering repeated, internally consistent symbols from additional observations.
Preserved transmitter-scale timing showing dot, dash, character, and word spacing ratios rather than receiver-strength averaging.
would_weaken: Additional exhaustive controls showing equally flexible transformations generate many standard symbols at comparable or higher rates.
Evidence that the observed envelope is fully explained by receiver beam response with no residual symbolic structure.
limitations: The six printer characters are receiver-strength codes and cannot be treated as transmitted Morse elements without an independently justified transformation.

hypotheses.label: Extraterrestrial technology
hypotheses.proposition: The historical event was produced by extraterrestrial technology.
hypotheses.rationale: Artificial-carrier compatibility and hydrogen-line context do not identify a technological source, establish extraterrestrial location, or exclude natural and terrestrial explanations.
would_strengthen: Independent repeated detections localized to an astronomical source with non-natural information-bearing structure.
A reproducible technosignature satisfying interference rejection, source localization, and multi-observatory confirmation requirements.
would_weaken: A verified natural, terrestrial, or instrumental mechanism reproducing all material properties of the event.
Failure of future targeted observations to recover any source-specific evidence does not by itself falsify a one-time event, but it prevents confirmation.
limitations: The repository does not assign extraterrestrial authorship from a single non-repeating, coarsely sampled event.
